narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Three angles of symmetry needs four arms, because the full turn is not counted.
<bookmark mark='four'/>Four arms with equal gaps fit after four turns, not three.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The full turn fits, so it is counted like every other turn.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Equal arms with equal gaps give as many angles of symmetry as there are arms.
